name: Myaccess
summary: Melbourne dialup/ADSL ISP; acquired by Datafast Telecommunications/Eftel in 2005 (EFTEL PTY LTD, ACN 073 238 178).

events.details: Acquired by Datafast Telecommunications/Eftel in 2005 (listed among Eftel's 2005 ISP acquisitions). The MyAccess brand actually left its homepage between Dec 2008 and Sep 2009, earlier than the proposal's 2009-2011 window. MyAccess homepage gone by Sep 2009.

refs.label: The Age Jul-2006: MyAccess among ISPs Eftel acquired in prior two years
21 Dec 2008 myaccess.com.au still served the MyAccess-branded ISP homepage
By 13 Sep 2009 the homepage was fully EFTel-branded (contrary to the proposal's 'still MyAccess in Sep 2009')
Verified verbatim on the ISP's own Dec 2005 page
ABR history verified: Eftel registered MY ACCESS within weeks of the mid-2005 acquisition
